subject: general
question: The custom of decorating eggs is practiced during which of the following festivals?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Easter.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **​​​​Easter, also known as Pascha **or** Resurrection Sunday,** is a Christian celebration and cultural holiday **honouring the resurrection of** **Jesus from the dead,** which the **New Testament claims** took place on the third day of his burial after his **Roman-style crucifixion at Calvary c.**
 
• One of the** major Christian feasts or holidays is Easter. **It commemorates the resurrection of **Jesus three days** after his crucifixion-related death.
 
• **Easter is observed by a large number** of Christians around the world with special church services, music, candlelight, flowers, and church bell ringing.** Easter has a secular component** in addition to its religious significance. ​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ​​​​​​​​​According to the official** Solar Hijri calendar of Iran,** the two-week **celebration of Navroz heralds the start of the New Year.** From the first to the** fourth day of Farvardin,** the first month of the **Iranian calendar**, which typically begins on March 21, there are four public holidays** associated with the celebration.**
 
• **Christmas is a Christian holiday** that commemorates Jesus' birth. Christmas in English, which means** "mass on Christ's day," **is a very modern invention. **The Anglo-Saxon gel or the Germanic **jl, which both referred to the winter solstice feast, may have been the source of the** earlier term Yule.**
 
• **Epiphany is a Christian** celebration that principally honours the Magi's visit to the** infant Jesus and John** the Baptist's baptism of him.
